notes.title: With regard to the bug event。
notes.content:
To all players:

Thank you very much for your support for the witch. This is the author's first work. Because you don't grasp some things in place, it is more like a traditional RPG game with a second breath.

Before this time, due to software problems, I changed the game from the original MV software to MZ software. Such a large-scale movement led to the breeding of some bugs. However, I didn't notice. I'm very sorry.

In order to make up for the days of bugs in the production group, the production group decided to compensate the players who bought the witch's secret medicine on steam for a set of flower wedding clothes. After all, the production group basically lost blood in Suoguo district this time. If it comes back later, the production group will also increase the CG corresponding to flower wedding and the CG corresponding to the clothes pointed out by all players.

This compensation will be put in the next update. Please give the production team some time. We have worked overtime to modify the bug. The bug will be updated together with the compensation.

I hope you players will be more considerate.

(the attached clothes are the draft of flower wedding, and the details behind are being painted.)
